purpose: This record preserves Rust Manifold cutover measurements, print surfaces, construction identities and published-view evidence.

engine.implementation: Pure Rust manifold boolean engine, with parallel feature; hsm-manifold shares immutable results and preserves mesh precision and construction/run IDs.

independent_operations.purpose: Compare both boolean engines on identical inputs before production integration.

part_generation.scope: Individual shared-host observations with retained import caches and construction-stage cache disabled; these are not isolated or statistical benchmarks.

complete_rust_path.purpose: Compare complete Rust part generation with the prior C++ construction and fabrication path.
complete_rust_path.source_changes: Boolean backend imports only; authored recipe sources match.

tests.wasm_test_scope: Build the default-feature kernel library for wasm32-unknown-unknown; native route-preview is excluded by --lib.

print_files.comparison_scope: Both directions sample every vertex, triangle centroid and edge midpoint. This samples surfaces; it is not an analytic continuous-surface proof.

surface.purpose: Compare full print surfaces with all vertex, edge-midpoint and triangle-centroid samples in both directions.
